title: 7 Things You Should Buy in Your 20s to Retire Rich
description:
Your 20s decide whether you're financially free at 35 or still stressed about rent. Here are the 7 purchases that actually move the needle — and #5 surprises almost everyone.

In this video, we break down the 7 smart purchases to make in your 20s if you want real wealth later: investing in a high-income skill, automating a Roth IRA, strategic travel using rewards points, real education (not debt-funded degrees), house hacking your way into real estate, buying reliable transportation instead of a status symbol, and protecting your health so you can actually execute on everything else.

This isn't financial advice — it's a breakdown of the patterns that consistently show up in people who build wealth early instead of waiting until their 30s to get serious about money. If you're tired of watching your bank balance stay the same every month, this one's for you.
